tier: paid: metered rotating residential and per-IP ISP

free_tier.stated: No recurring free allowance for proxy traffic: Datacenter, ISP and Residential proxies are not covered by the 5,000 monthly free credits. New accounts get a one-time USD 2 trial credit for the proxy products (valid 7 days) and a USD 5 bonus on adding a payment method (valid 30 days).
free_tier.notes: The 5,000 monthly free credits (about USD 7.50) cover the Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API, renew on the first of each month and do not roll over. Unfunded accounts are limited to 1,000 requests per minute across the SERP API, Web Unlocker API and proxy products; adding funds removes the limit.

per_object_cap.notes: The unit sold is bandwidth (GB through the proxy) or an address (one ISP IP), never a stored object.

retention.stated: not applicable: a live proxy session, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Rotating residential traffic is metered per GB: $8/GB list, $4/GB with code RESIGB50, then plan volume of $499/month for 141 GB, $999/month for 332 GB and $1,999/month for 798 GB with no rollover. ISP proxies are priced per IP instead of per byte: $1.80/IP shared at 10 IPs down to $1.30 at 1,000, and $3.50/IP dedicated at 10 down to $2.50 at 1,000.
egress.price_per_tb: $8,192/TB at the $8/GB list rate and $4,096/TB at the $4/GB coupon rate, by arithmetic on the per-GB price the vendor states; the vendor prices in GB, not TB

interface_detail: HTTP/S and SOCKS5 forward proxy; residential traffic also over the QUIC protocol (HTTP/3). Zones and IPs are managed from the Control Panel or the API, and ISP proxies keep one static address per IP. No interface term names a proxy transport, so the transports are listed here.
tooling: Any HTTP client that accepts a proxy: curl --proxy brd.superproxy.io:44445 --proxy-user brd-customer-<customer_id>-zone-<zone_name>:<zone_password>, or a SOCKS5 client. Targeting and sessions are options in the proxy username (-country-, -city-, -asn-, -os-, -session-). A session string keeps one peer while it is unchanged and for up to 5 minutes idle, a keep-alive request every 30 seconds holds it longer, and an unavailable peer answers 502 No peers available once before a new peer is assigned. Residential and Web Unlocker traffic needs the Bright Data SSL certificate for end-to-end TLS.
chaining: A Cloudflare Worker sends its outbound request to the proxy endpoint; Bright Data supplies the exit address the target sees, so the Worker's own egress is unchanged and the address is the only thing bought.

limits_note: Residential zones created after July 7, 2026 need a human-reviewed KYC approval, open only to registered companies that verify a corporate email domain, started only after real funds are added, and submitted with a company registration document; ISP and Datacenter proxies and the Web Unlocker API need no KYC. Approved residential traffic is scoped to the KYC use case: requests to domains or categories outside it return an Access denied error. Government websites are blocked on every network. There is no no-KYC residential path for a zone created after July 7, 2026: an Add-a-Zone request from an account that has not completed KYC is blocked with HTTP 403 and the compliance error kyc_required or business_account_required. The immediate (no-KYC) residential access mode, with its 402 bad_endpoint errors, applies only to zones created on or before July 7, 2026, and immediate access to the Residential network is no longer supported effective 2026-10-19. The trust-center KYC FAQ still offers immediate residential proxy access without KYC and links to an immediate-access section that the Residential network access policy no longer has; that FAQ page was last modified on 2025-09-08.
binding_note: Residential access is gated by a KYC review open only to registered companies, a gate that no limits[] kind names. Of the kinds, volume-quota binds: residential traffic is billed per GB from the first byte, USD 4.00/GB with code RESIGB50 (USD 8 list) on pay as you go, and no recurring free allowance covers proxy traffic.

identity_cost.detail: Residential: a registered company that verifies a corporate email domain, funds on the account balance, and a KYC form with the business, the use case and a company registration document, reviewed by a person; the status is updated within 48 hours of completing the process. The compliance team may ask for a government-issued ID of the point of contact, such as a driver's license or passport, and for a brief video call. Accounts on a personal email (Gmail, Outlook, iCloud) cannot be approved. ISP and Datacenter proxies and the Web Unlocker API need no KYC; adding a payment method verifies an account.
identity_cost.country: registered company with a verified corporate email domain

reliability_note: The mobile proxy product page https://brightdata.com/proxy-types/mobile-proxies answers with a temporary redirect to https://brightdata.com/proxy-types, which lists Residential, Datacenter and ISP proxies; the proxy documentation lists Residential, Data Center and ISP networks only. The Mobile entry left the public proxy listing between 2026-04-12 and 2026-04-14: the Mobile IPs tab of https://brightdata.com/locations is present in the archived copy of 2026-04-12 and absent in the archived copy of 2026-04-14, and https://brightdata.com/proxy-types lists Mobile in the archived copy of 2026-03-24 and no longer lists it in the archived copy of 2026-04-14. The mobile pricing page was still served on 2026-04-15, the documentation index still listed the mobile network pages on 2026-05-10 and no longer listed them on 2026-05-20, and the mobile product page and the mobile pricing page are redirects in the archived copies of 2026-08-13. A release note dated 2026-10-24 tells customers to switch their immediate-access Residential and immediate-access Mobile proxies to ISP proxies or the Web Unlocker API, and states that those retired proxies will be deleted from their owners' accounts on 2026-11-09. A third-party report (Proxyway, Proxy Market Research 2026) also dates the discontinuation to April 2026.
